req.title: Login required for update
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they attempt GET /<id>/update.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-013 requires that anonymous (unauthenticated) users attempting GET /<id>/update are redirected to /auth/login. Three test cases are designed: (1) positive — an authenticated user can access the update page (status 200, no redirect), confirming the login_required decorator only blocks anonymous users; (2) negative — an anonymous user gets a 302 redirect to /auth/login (the core requirement); (3) boundary — the redirect Location header must be exactly '/auth/login' (not a prefix, not a superset), and the status code must be exactly 302 (not 301, not 303). Each test uses the pre-loaded fixture data (user id=1, post id=1) and drives the app in-process via app.test_client().

tests.name: test_anonymous_get_update_redirects_to_login
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
Database contains pre-loaded fixture: user id=1 (test/test), post id=1
No session cookie is set (anonymous client)
trace: R-FLASKR-013: anonymous GET /<id>/update must redirect to /auth/login
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_anonymous_get_update_redirects_to_login():
    r = client.get('/1/update')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

test_anonymous_get_update_redirects_to_login()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_authenticated_user_can_access_update_page():
    login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    assert login_r.status_code == 302
    r = client.get('/1/update')
    assert r.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_anonymous_redirect_location_is_exactly_auth_login
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
Database contains pre-loaded fixture: user id=1 (test/test), post id=1
No session cookie is set (anonymous client)
actions: Inspect the exact value of the Location header and the exact status code
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 302 (not 301, not 303, not 200)
Location header is exactly the string '/auth/login' (not '/auth/login/', not '/login', not any other path)
trace: R-FLASKR-013: redirect must be to /auth/login specifically; boundary test catches wrong status code or wrong redirect target mutations
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_anonymous_redirect_location_is_exactly_auth_login():
    r = client.get('/1/update')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303
    assert r.status_code != 200
    location = r.headers['Location']
    assert location == '/auth/login'
    assert location != '/auth/login/'
    assert location != '/login'
    assert location != '/auth/register'

test_anonymous_redirect_location_is_exactly_auth_login()

tests.name: test_state_transition_login_then_logout_then_update_redirects
preconditions: App is initialised with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
Database contains pre-loaded fixture: user id=1 (test/test), post id=1
Client starts anonymous, logs in, then logs out
expected: After logout: Location header is exactly '/auth/login'
trace: R-FLASKR-013: state transition — authenticated->anonymous transition must re-engage the redirect
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_state_transition_login_then_logout_then_update_redirects():
    login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
    assert login_r.status_code == 302
    r_auth = client.get('/1/update')
    assert r_auth.status_code == 200
    logout_r = client.get('/auth/logout')
    assert logout_r.status_code == 302
    r_anon = client.get('/1/update')
    assert r_anon.status_code == 302
    assert r_anon.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

test_state_transition_login_then_logout_then_update_redirects()
